Records.description: Triangle ladder family, triangle-ladder_L3_massless-internal-offshell-external. The Usyukina-Davydychev triangle ladder $T^{(L)}$ consists of $(L{-}1)$ box cells capped by a triangle at the apex, with two rails of $L$ edges converging to a shared apex vertex and $L$ rungs connecting the rails at each level. It has $2L{+}1$ vertices, $3L$ massless internal propagators, $L$ loops, and three off-shell external legs at the two base vertices and the apex. The triangle ladder evaluates to the same $\Phi^{(L)}$ as the four-point box ladder and the generalised-ladder fan via the conformal magic identity, but is a genuinely different topology from both for $L \ge 2$: the triangle ladder has $V = 2L{+}1$, $E = 3L$ versus $V = L{+}2$, $E = 2L{+}1$ for the fan. Only $L = 1$ (the triangle) is shared.
Records.title: An approach to the evaluation of three and four point ladder diagrams
Records.authors: N. I. Usyukina, A. I. Davydychev

Results.normalization: Exact finite conformal integral: the weight-6 Usyukina--Davydychev function $\Phi^{(3)}(z,\bar z)$ (the $3$-loop ladder), written as explicit classical polylogarithms $\operatorname{Li}_j$ in the conformal cross-ratios $z,\bar z$ (grounded in the external kinematics; the external scale prefactor is stripped). Not a dim-reg series. The numeric is its value at the reference point $z=1/3$, $\bar z=1/5$.

source.title: Exact results for three and four point ladder diagrams with an arbitrary number of rungs
source.authors: N. I. Usyukina, A. I. Davydychev

import.method: Usyukina-Davydychev triangle ladder: value is Phi^(L)(z,zbar) at z=1/3, zbar=1/5 (same Phi^(L) as the 4-mass box ladder). Triangle anchor T^(L) = Phi^(L)(x,y)/(p3^2)^L, c0=1, validated by pySecDec at L=1 (12 digits) and L=2 (no-refit ~1e-5).
